title: Grade 5 French — Fri, May 29
description: Food & Meals (La Nourriture et les Repas) — Day 5 of 5
subject: french

questions.question: What is the French word for 'bread'?
questions.explanation: 'Pain' = bread. Fromage = cheese, Beurre = butter, Lait = milk.

questions.question: How do you say 'I am hungry' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai faim' = 'I am hungry' (literally 'I have hunger'). French uses 'avoir' (to have) for hunger and thirst.

questions.question: What does 'Je voudrais un café' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais' = 'I would like' (polite form of wanting). Used when ordering food or making requests.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'water'?
questions.explanation: 'Eau' = water. Vin = wine, Jus = juice, Lait = milk. 'Une bouteille d'eau' = a bottle of water.

questions.question: What is 'le petit-déjeuner'?
questions.explanation: 'Le petit-déjeuner' = breakfast (literally 'the little lunch'). Le déjeuner = lunch, Le dîner = dinner.

questions.question: How do you say 'I like apples' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime les pommes' = 'I like apples'. 'Pomme' = apple. Note the definite article 'les' with likes/dislikes.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'cheese'?
questions.explanation: 'Fromage' = cheese. France is famous for over 400 types of cheese!

questions.question: 'J'ai soif' means:
questions.explanation: 'J'ai soif' = 'I am thirsty' (literally 'I have thirst'). French uses 'avoir' for soif (thirst).

questions.question: How do you say 'lunch' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le déjeuner' = lunch (midday meal). Le goûter = afternoon snack (children's 4pm snack in France).

questions.question: What does 'Bon appétit!' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Bon appétit!' = 'Enjoy your meal!' — said before eating. This French expression is used worldwide.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'vegetables'?
questions.explanation: 'Légumes' = vegetables. Fruits = fruits, Viandes = meats, Céréales = cereals/grains.

questions.question: How do you order food politely in a restaurant?
options: Je voudrais le steak, s'il vous plaît
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais le steak, s'il vous plaît' = 'I would like the steak, please' — the polite way to order.

questions.question: What is 'le dîner' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le dîner' = dinner (evening meal). In France, dinner is typically eaten around 7–8 PM.

questions.question: How do you say 'I don't like spinach' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je n'aime pas les épinards' = 'I don't like spinach'. Negation: ne...pas around the verb. 'Épinards' = spinach.
